description: This file contains utility functions for image processing, specifically padding images to a certain size and scaling images with high-quality resampling using Catmull–Rom interpolation.

methods.name: export function padImageToSize(image: ImageData, size: { width: number, height: number }): Image/ padImageToSize
methods.description: Pads an image to a target size by copying existing pixel data and filling additional areas with transparent black pixels.

methods.name: export function scaleImageToSize(image: ImageData, size: { width: number; height: number }): Ima/ scaleImageToSize
methods.description: Scales an image to a specified size using Catmull–Rom interpolation for smooth resizing.
